title: Synthetic consumer compatibility test
method: Six fictional supported clients receive the same synthetic response containing an added enum value. Four accept it and two reject it. Passing fraction is 4/6 ≈ 66.7%; this is a compatibility exercise, not production telemetry.
alt: Synthetic consumer compatibility test. Accept new enum value: 4 clients; Reject new enum value: 2 clients. Illustrative inputs.
